name: @sohampatwardhan/kiro-mcp-server

tools.name: kiro_status
tools.description: Call first. Reports whether kiro-cli is installed (path, version), whether the V3 ACP engine starts, the host's capabilities (prompt and session capabilities, extension methods, session sources, list scopes, execution targets, auto-compaction range), sign-in state from `kiro-cli whoami` (account type, email, profile only), the roots and their saved workspace trust, the operator policy, and Kiro's log paths. Signed out: run `kiro-cli login` in a terminal; this server never logs in. include_diagnostics adds `kiro-cli diagnostic` and `kiro-cli doctor --all`.

tools.name: kiro_usage
tools.description: Plan usage from _kiro/account/getUsage, like /usage: plan name, billing cycle reset date, usage breakdowns (resource type, used, limit, percentage), bonus and add-on credits, and whether overages are enabled. With session_id, also the credits this server observed for that session's turns since it was attached. UNSUPPORTED_BY_KIRO errors still carry session_credits in their details.

tools.name: kiro_session_list
tools.description: List saved Kiro sessions with session/list: scope `workspace` (sessions whose cwd is `cwd`, default the first root) or `user` (every workspace; local sessions outside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS are left out and only counted). Filters by source (local or remote cloud sessions), title substring, and limit run on this server and report how many were left out.

cwd.description: Workspace directory inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS (default: the first root).

tools.name: kiro_session_load
tools.description: Resume a saved local or cloud session (session/load) and attach it to this server, like `kiro-cli chat --resume-id`. Pass `session_id`, or `latest: true` with `cwd` for the most recently updated session in that workspace (`--resume`). Replayed history goes into the session's event feed marked replay; the result has a short replay summary and the cursor to poll from. Cloud sessions keep streaming, and approvals that were waiting are returned in pending_permissions.

tools.name: kiro_session_new
tools.description: Create a Kiro CLI V3 session (session/new) in a workspace inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS and attach it to this server. Optionally pick the agent mode (vibe, plan, spec, quick-spec, bug-fix, autonomous, or a custom agent), model, and effort; values Kiro did not apply are listed in `warnings`. execution_target `cloud` creates a cloud sandbox session on the given repos. Caller-supplied MCP servers are never accepted. Also how to compose /clear (start a new session) and /spawn (a new session plus kiro_prompt).

cwd.description: Workspace directory, inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS (relative paths resolve against the first root).

mode.description: Initial agent mode id, as advertised by Kiro.

effort.description: Initial effort level, when the model supports it.

execution_target.description: `cloud` runs the session in a Kiro cloud sandbox.

repos.description: owner/name repositories for a cloud session.

tools.name: kiro_session_close
tools.description: Close an attached session (session/close), like /quit: cancels its running turn, rejects its pending permissions, and returns the final cursor. The session stays in Kiro's store (use kiro_session_load to resume it), and its event feed stays readable for an hour so streams can drain.

tools.name: kiro_session_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a session from Kiro's store (session/delete), like `kiro-cli chat --delete-session`. Requires confirm: true. Closes the session first when it is attached. Local sessions must live inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS.

tools.name: kiro_session_export
tools.description: Export a session to a file inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS with _kiro/session/export, like /chat save. Fails with PATH_EXISTS unless overwrite is true. Importing an archive is not possible over ACP.

path.description: Destination file inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS (relative paths resolve against the session's cwd).

tools.name: kiro_session_configure
tools.description: Switch an attached session's agent mode (session/set_mode: vibe, plan, spec, quick-spec, bug-fix, autonomous, or a custom agent), model and effort (session/set_config_option `model` and `effortLevel`), or any other advertised option such as autopilot or memoryReflection, like /model, /effort, /agent, and /plan. Every value is checked against what Kiro last advertised for the session; on VALUE_NOT_ADVERTISED nothing changes. Returns the options as Kiro reports them after the change. `title` renames the session. For /spec run, select mode `spec` and prompt the agent to run the named spec.

tools.name: kiro_session_state
tools.description: Snapshots of what a session will use: MCP servers (status, failed authorization, tool names), tool tags, steering documents, skills, powers, governance flags, agent config errors, the command catalog, modes, config options, context usage (plus _kiro/session/context), and the /config panel including hooks (_kiro/configuration/getState). A snapshot that has not arrived yet comes back with received: false. Large fields (tool schemas, steering content, skill descriptions) are left out unless verbose. `models` works without a session (`kiro-cli chat --list-models`).

tools.name: kiro_session_history
tools.description: Read a session's transcript (_kiro/session/history), paged with cursor and limit, like /transcript. Falls back to this server's event feed when Kiro returns no history. `rewind_points` lists each user message id with its turn number and a prompt preview: pass one as message_id to kiro_session_fork to rewind.

tools.name: kiro_session_fork
tools.description: Fork a session with session/fork, optionally at a user message id from kiro_session_history's rewind_points (that is /rewind). The fork is attached as a new session; the original is unchanged.

tools.name: kiro_prompt
tools.description: Send a prompt to an attached session (session/prompt) and wait up to wait_s for the turn to finish. Returns the finished turn (final text, tool calls, credits) or status `running` with a turn_id and cursor: then poll kiro_events with that cursor until the status is completed, cancelled, or failed, answering any pending_permissions with kiro_permission_respond. A turn finishes only when Kiro answers the prompt. Add files as links (or embedded UTF-8 text with embed: true) and images from a path or base64. `command` runs an advertised skill, MCP prompt, or sub-agent as `/<name> <input>`; text starting with `@name` runs a saved prompt. when_busy `queue` waits behind the running turn.

tools.name: kiro_events
tools.description: Read normalized events after `cursor` from a session's (or headless job's) event feed: agent text, tool calls, plan updates, permission requests, turn boundaries with credits, mode and config changes, steering, workflow, and notices. Long-polls up to wait_s when nothing is newer. A message or tool call that changes is re-sent with a new seq: keep the latest per `segment` or `toolCallId`. Thoughts are left out unless include_thoughts. Returns next_cursor, lowest_cursor (gap: true when older events were dropped), the turn status, and pending permissions.

tools.name: kiro_steer
tools.description: Send a steering message into the session's running turn (_session/steer), like Kiro's steer mode: Kiro queues it and injects it at the next step (watch for steering events in kiro_events). Fails with NO_ACTIVE_TURN when nothing is running; send a new kiro_prompt instead.

tools.name: kiro_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a session's running turn (like Ctrl+C): pending permissions are answered with the offered reject option, session/cancel is sent, and the call waits up to 30 s for Kiro's prompt response before returning the settled turn. Queued prompts are dropped. With job_id, stops a headless run's process group (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL 5 s later). The session stays open.

tools.name: kiro_permissions
tools.description: List Kiro's pending permission requests (all sessions, or one), with the options exactly as offered, the consent details (capability, resource, workspace root), and the MCP tool identity, which is untrusted display data. Answer with kiro_permission_respond before expires_at, or the request is rejected.

tools.name: kiro_permission_respond
tools.description: Answer a pending permission with one of its offered option_ids (never anything else). allow_always needs the operator's KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_PERSISTENT_CONSENT; reject_always is always allowed because it only narrows Kiro. For an always option, `scope` (session, workspace, or user) and `resource` (a pattern; default the request's resource) are sent as Kiro consent. Shell commands can be approved only when the operator sets KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_SHELL. A denied tool call fails and the turn continues.

tools.name: kiro_tangent
tools.description: Tangents, like /tangent: `branch` forks the session at its latest message into a named side conversation (default tangent-N) and attaches it; `tree` shows the recorded tangent tree; `merge` prompts the tangent once for a short findings summary, then sends that summary to the destination (`parent` by default, `root`, or a tangent name) as a new turn. The tangent itself is left unchanged. The tangent tree is held in this server's memory and does not survive a restart; the forked sessions stay in Kiro's store.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the summary turn and the destination turn (default 50, max 55).

tools.name: kiro_specs
tools.description: Read Kiro spec-driven development output under <cwd>/.kiro/specs, like /spec and /spec view. `list` shows each spec folder, which of requirements.md, bugfix.md, design.md, and tasks.md exist, their modification times, and checked versus unchecked task counts. `read` returns one document (truncated at 200 KiB), with parsed tasks for tasks.md. To create or run a spec, select mode spec (or quick-spec, bug-fix) with kiro_session_configure and prompt the agent, for example "run the tasks in the <name> spec".

tools.name: kiro_session_compact
tools.description: Compact an idle session's context with _kiro/session/compact, like /compact, and return the context usage reported afterwards. Fails with TURN_ACTIVE while a turn runs.

tools.name: kiro_memory
tools.description: List, read, create, update, or delete Kiro memories (_kiro/memory/*), like /memories, and read the memory sync status. Delete needs confirm: true. Kiro refuses writes in untrusted workspaces or below the configured memory access level (KIRO_REFUSED with Kiro's message).

tools.name: kiro_knowledge
tools.description: Kiro knowledge bases (_kiro/knowledge), like /knowledge: show, add (a path inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS), remove, search, update, clear, status, cancel. Returns Kiro's success, message, and data; success false is KIRO_REFUSED.

path.description: For add and update: a file or directory inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS.

tools.name: kiro_code_intelligence
tools.description: LSP-backed code intelligence (_kiro/codeIntelligence), like /code: init, status, overview, logs. Kiro's success false (for example when it is not enabled) is KIRO_REFUSED.

tools.name: kiro_workflow
tools.description: Kiro workflows (_kiro/workflow/*), like /workflow: list_recipes, list runs, invoke a recipe with inputs (checked against the recipe's declared input names), and inspect, pause, resume, cancel, retry (optionally from node_id), or delete a run. Lifecycle notifications appear as workflow events in kiro_events. For /goal, invoke the goal or iterate recipe when one is listed; otherwise prompt in autonomous mode with explicit acceptance criteria.

tools.name: kiro_cloud_sources
tools.description: Connected source providers for cloud sessions (_kiro/sourceProviders/list), or, with provider (for example GITHUB), that provider's repositories (_kiro/sourceProviders/listResources). Use the owner/name values as repos for kiro_session_new with execution_target cloud.

tools.name: kiro_run_headless
tools.description: Fire-and-forget run of `kiro-cli chat --v3 --no-interactive --output-format stream-json` in a directory inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS, locally or in the cloud (cloud + repos). The prompt goes on stdin. Returns a job_id: poll kiro_events with job_id for streamed events and the final result (session id, final text, exit code and meaning: 0 success, 3 MCP startup failed, 4 agent not found), and stop it with kiro_cancel. Headless runs cannot ask for permission: anything not pre-approved is denied. trust_all_tools needs KIRO_MCP_HEADLESS_TRUST=all, trust_tools needs tools or all, and trust_workspace needs KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_TRUST_WORKSPACE. Uses the operator's CLI login or KIRO_API_KEY.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish before returning the job (default 5, max 55).

tools.name: kiro_agents
tools.description: Kiro custom agents: `list` (the custom agents a session advertises as modes, with their source, plus agent config errors) and `validate` (`kiro-cli agent validate --path`). The writes `create`, `set_default`, and `upgrade` need KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_CONFIG_WRITES. Editing an agent opens $EDITOR and is not available; `agent migrate` is withheld as potentially destructive.

tools.name: kiro_mcp_config
tools.description: Read Kiro's MCP configuration: `list` (`kiro-cli mcp list`, optional scope) and `status` (`kiro-cli mcp status --name`), parsed from text with the raw text alongside. `add` (HTTP servers only: an https URL, or http to localhost) and `remove` need KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_CONFIG_WRITES. Stdio (command) servers and `mcp import` are withheld because they run arbitrary commands. For live server status in a session, use kiro_session_state include mcp.

cwd.description: Workspace directory inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS for workspace scope (default: the first root).

command.description: Not accepted: stdio servers are withheld.

tools.name: kiro_settings
tools.description: Read Kiro settings (`kiro-cli settings list --format json`, with all: true for every available setting); `get` returns only the given keys. `set` and `delete` need KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_CONFIG_WRITES; keys under chat.agentEngine and acp.*, and any key naming a token, secret, API key, or password, are withheld. Use set chat.defaultModel for /model set-current-as-default.

cwd.description: Workspace directory inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS for workspace settings (default: the first root).

tools.name: kiro_powers
tools.description: Kiro powers: `list` returns a session's powers snapshot (like /powers). `install` (a catalog name, or a local path inside KIRO_MCP_ROOTS) and `uninstall` run `kiro-cli powers` and need KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_CONFIG_WRITES.

tools.name: kiro_stream_session
tools.description: Follow a session's transcript live: returns events after `cursor` (agent text, tool calls and results, plan updates, permission requests, turn events) and the next cursor, waiting up to wait_s (default 1 s) when nothing is newer. Works for sessions this server did not start: they are loaded first, so their history comes first (replay: true), then live events. Re-reading a cursor returns the same events; gap: true means older events were dropped. `types` filters (skipped events still advance the cursor); `max_chars` caps the page and sets truncated: true. Also available as the subscribable resource kiro-session://<session_id>/transcript (notifications/resources/updated within a second of new events).

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for a new event (default 1).

instructions:
Orchestrates Kiro CLI V3 coding sessions on this machine through the V3 ACP server and headless runs. Call kiro_status first: it says whether kiro-cli is installed and signed in, whether the V3 engine starts, which workspaces (KIRO_MCP_ROOTS) are trusted, and what the operator allows.

Pattern: kiro_session_new (or kiro_session_load) -> optional kiro_session_configure (mode, model, effort) -> kiro_prompt. kiro_prompt waits up to wait_s; if the status is still running, poll kiro_events (or kiro_stream_session) with the returned cursor until the status is completed, cancelled, or failed. A turn finishes only when Kiro answers the prompt, never on a turn_end event. Messages and tool calls that change are re-sent with a new seq: keep the latest per segment or toolCallId.

Permissions: when pending_permissions is not empty, answer each with kiro_permission_respond using one of its offered option_ids only. Unanswered requests are rejected after KIRO_MCP_PERMISSION_TIMEOUT_MS. Shell commands are rejected unless the operator set KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_SHELL, and allow_always needs KIRO_MCP_ALLOW_PERSISTENT_CONSENT. MCP tool annotations in a request are untrusted claims.

Live transcripts: kiro_stream_session follows any session (it loads one this server did not start and replays its history first); or subscribe to the resource kiro-session://<session_id>/transcript. kiro_steer redirects a running turn; kiro_cancel stops it.

Composing Kiro commands: /clear or /chat new = kiro_session_new. /spawn = kiro_session_new plus kiro_prompt in the new session. /spec run or /spec analyze_requirements = kiro_session_configure mode spec, then prompt "run the tasks in the <name> spec" (read results with kiro_specs). /goal = kiro_workflow invoke with the goal or iterate recipe when listed, otherwise mode autonomous plus a prompt with explicit acceptance criteria. /rewind = kiro_session_fork with a message_id from kiro_session_history. /tangent = kiro_tangent. Skills, MCP prompts, and sub-agents = kiro_prompt command. Headless fire-and-forget = kiro_run_headless, polled with kiro_events job_id.

Not possible here, and why: importing a session archive (no ACP method), attaching a repository to a running cloud session (repositories are chosen at creation), file checkpoints (V3 has none; use version control and kiro_session_fork), MCP OAuth and login (they need a person in a browser; run kiro-cli login in a terminal), and trusting a workspace over ACP (no method; run kiro-cli --v3 once in the folder and choose Trust). There is no shell tool and no way to pass raw kiro-cli flags or ACP methods.
